items.prompt: Which statement justifies retaining a root after a bisection update?

options.text: Continuity and opposite signs on the retained half
options.why: The intermediate value theorem applies to that subinterval.

options.text: A sign jump always contains an exact zero
Every root has opposite signs around it
options.why: Even-multiplicity roots can touch zero without crossing.

options.text: A tiny residual proves the unique root is close
options.why: Location sensitivity and uniqueness need more information.

items.explanation: Bisection preserves a theorem-backed interval, not only a promising-looking point.
